values.en: Choose a homeomorphism $f:X\to Y$ in the stated sense: a continuous open bijection. Its bijectivity gives an inverse $g:Y\to X$. For every open $U\subseteq X$, the inverse image $g^{-1}(U)=f(U)$ is open because $f$ is open; hence $g$ is continuous. The composites $g\circ f$ and $f\circ g$ equal the respective identity maps. Constant homotopies therefore prove both homotopy-inverse laws, yielding a homotopy-equivalence witness.
values.zh-CN: 取所定义意义下的同胚 $f:X\to Y$，即连续、开且双射的映射。由双射性得到逆映射 $g:Y\to X$。对任意开集 $U\subseteq X$，有 $g^{-1}(U)=f(U)$；因 $f$ 是开映射，该集合在 $Y$ 中开，故 $g$ 连续。两个复合 $g\circ f$、$f\circ g$ 严格等于相应恒等映射。因此常值同伦给出两条同伦逆律，得到同伦等价见证。

values.en: Homeomorphic spaces are homotopy equivalent proof
values.zh-CN: 同胚空间同伦等价的证明
